feature_completion_policy: Partial catalog entries identify working subsets, not fulfilled acceptance criteria. No feature is claimed verified in the full catalog.

phases.available: Qt-free core, CPU reference renderer, locked infrastructure dependencies, bounded OpenToonz source audit and save failure tests.
phases.remaining: Renderer comparison, successful reuse extraction/build audit, fill spike and broader deformation/renderer comparisons, device matrix and production budgets.

phases.available: Native English QML shell, CMake modules, commands, immutable snapshots, undo/redo and validation. Integrated resizable timing/curve workspace and selection-owned object/layer Properties. Shared compact controls, optional curve numeric fields and a draggable workspace divider with dynamic bounds. Typed layer-transform property addresses now distinguish rest, authored keys and evaluated values with atomic edits. Format-4 typed character/peg/part addresses and source-version migration backups now persist and reject invalid references.
phases.remaining: Docking/workspace persistence, configurable shortcuts, full accessibility, scalable resource/cache protocols and cross-platform qualification.

phases.available: Mouse pencil, exposures, onion skin, playback, save/reopen, 48-frame 1080p PNG export, and atomic registered transparent PNG parts/numbered-sequence intake.
phases.remaining: Full phase feature acceptance and animator-led workflow checks; large-project behavior and all fixture gates.

phases.available: Synchronized virtualized timeline/Xsheet, create/hold/clear exposures, insert/remove frames and navigate drawings. Multi-layer range clipboard, independent drawing paste, key paste, cycles, ones/twos/threes, overwrite retiming, Alt-drag moves, markers and bounded Xsheet PDF export. Clear removes selected exposures and pose keys together. Timeline/Xsheet diamonds can be dragged directly; Keys mode adds poses by double-click, with adjustable timeline cell width.
phases.remaining: Frame annotations/thumbnails, advanced onion/tracing controls, paperless workflows and artist acceptance.

phases.available: Sampled vector strokes, approximate eraser, primitives, single-stroke selection, point editing/smoothing, stable palette IDs and shape recoloring. Rectangular whole-stroke multi-selection, move/duplicate/delete, flips and quarter turns preserve editable geometry, swatch and art-layer IDs. On-canvas scale/rotation handles with live previews and explicit selected-vector properties. Thin vectors have a constant screen-space hit margin respecting art order; point dragging previews the complete stroke, with contextual tool/handle cursors. Pencil/polygon points can be inserted on segments by double-click and deleted individually while preserving identity, pressure interpolation and minimum geometry. Shift/Alt add/subtract whole vectors by click or marquee, with sparse membership, individual selection bounds, tool-switch preservation and identity-safe duplication. Whole-footprint vector lasso with modifiers, select all/invert, cross-scene vector cut/copy/paste, local nudges, alignment/distribution, art-layer stacking, batch styles, corner-aware smoothing, pressure-aware simplification, constrained lines/primitives and drawing-local grid/snapping.
phases.remaining: Region topology/fill, analytic erasing, Bezier/contour/width editors, presets/textures, advanced guides, partial contour and raster lasso selection, geometry combining and production-scale optimization.

phases.available: Sparse immutable 15-bit premultiplied tiles, libmypaint ink/soft/dry/smudge/eraser presets, pressure input, cancellable gestures, shared preview/export and compressed project resources. Brush opacity and rectangular pixel selection with integer move/duplicate/delete, flips and lossless quarter turns, alpha-safe overlap and guarded canvas bounds. Free scale/rotation preview and commit using nearest-neighbor sampling with transparent surroundings.
phases.remaining: Brush texture/import/preset management, lasso/soft masks, high-quality resampling and transform performance qualification, resolution changes, production workload and physical-device qualification.

phases.available: Layer transform keys with linear/held/smooth interpolation, inherited transforms/opacity, explicit Setup/Animate and Auto key, key navigation/state, editable pose-channel graph and key-only multi-layer retiming with collision rejection. Curves stay in the main workspace; timeline/Xsheet range-end dragging stretches timing. Animate (A) records layer poses directly with move/scale/rotation handles and an initial anchor. Per-channel normalized Bezier handles, overshoot presets, graph key creation and a evaluated canvas trajectory share evaluation with export. All motion defaults to normalized combined channels with in-place channel selection, square-key editing, linked/unlinked easing handles, a full-pose retiming lane and time zoom/panning. Shared sparse pose-key selection, direct group drag/Alt-duplicate, right-edge timing stretch, keyboard nudges/delete and local-unit motion copy/paste with collision protection and atomic undo. Animate Path mode edits individual pose positions directly on the canvas, with fixed drawing references, animated-parent mapping, screen-axis constraints, sampled pose insertion and atomic preview/undo. Batch full-pose interpolation/easing and append-key-block repetition preserve poses, reject collisions atomically and extend duration with one undo. A compact Pose menu copies layer transforms, pastes full or position/rotation/scale/opacity/pivot channels, mirrors horizontal/vertical scale and resets setup/keyed poses. One orthographic output camera has direct pan/rotate/zoom handles, frame keys, guides and preview/reopen/PNG parity.
phases.remaining: Independent channel keys, linked/free analytic tangents, separate spatial paths and velocity, multi-layer/channel-mask batched editing and world-space motion retargeting, multiplane staging and camera switching.

phases.available: Exact rational frame-to-sample arithmetic has a domain test; no audio playback.
phases.remaining: Audio decode/timeline/waveform/sync, mouth mapping/manual lip correction, optional detection, media policies, FFmpeg adapter and video output.

phases.available: Accepted bounded HM-03 rigid-character contract: 19-part original-art assembly, coordinated views, pixel-equivalent reopen and independent copy. Parented layers and typed character roots, pegs and Parts; role editing, preserve-world rigid reparenting within shared animated ancestry, stable rest pivots, named held substitutions, renderer-backed thumbnails and coordinated view sets. Batch Part assembly, independent or explicitly linked-artwork Part/Peg branch copies, safe branch deletion, Part detachment, Peg dissolution and view-range edits preserve view membership through save/reopen. Format-12 named masked poses capture selected/all Parts and selected transform/drawing channels, apply with atomic undo, and save/reopen. The direct pose slider blends from the current evaluated pose with an explicit 50% drawing threshold and one undo per drag. Format-13 publication filters named poses/views into a compact Animator dashboard; a local Rig/Animator workspace switch preserves selection, frame and render pixels.
phases.remaining: Independent second-animator review, reparenting across differently animated branches, cross-rig pose transfer/mirroring, Quick Rig, general typed controls, conflict handling, complete workspace presets, portable assets/templates and production-scale qualification.

phases.available: Accepted bounded HM-05 format-8 per-substitution rest meshes and UVs; direct mouse editing, alpha-bounded image grids, editable vector source through a bounded raster proxy, static pose/reset, undo and matching preview/output rendering. Format-9 keyed two-segment bone or cubic curve per substitution, saved weights/controls, direct canvas drag with cancellation, posed mesh grid, Rest key, undo and preview/output parity. Format 10 introduced a child-Part link to its direct parent's evaluated bone tip; format 11 saves the rest tip and distal axis at attachment time. Same-Part range copy/paste, move and stretch transfer keyed deformer poses. Native linked 15-part and unlinked 19-part subset p95 and process peak memory pass the proposed limits on the measured M1 Pro profile.
phases.remaining: Complete HM-06 extreme-bend and seam quality, influence tuning and full-shot interaction/memory budgets and artistic review; then portable cross-Part key transfer, constraints, multiple-pose rig breadth and full phase qualification.

phases.available: Qt-free typed image/transform/matte graph, validated DAG, hierarchy-aware invalidation, explicit Display/Write outputs, alpha matte and opt-in saved linear-sRGB composition. A bounded revision cache reuses canvas frames and speculatively prepares the next frame from an immutable snapshot. Native playback/scrub, alpha/color charts and animated original artwork close bounded HM-04; orthographic camera output joins HM-13. Legacy scenes keep their direct-painter appearance.
phases.remaining: Editable node UI, useful effects, full ROI scheduling, production-scale performance and later deformer integration.

phases.available: Saved revisions, recovery UX, English guide, regression tests and source CI are initial prerequisites. Format 1/2 migration backups, format 3 curve metadata and checked compressed media resources, explicit backed-up compaction and asynchronous recovery snapshots. Requested arm64 macOS preview now includes audited runtime dependencies, notices, matching source archives/recipes and verified ad-hoc signatures. Format-7 output-camera migration and source-version backups have local failure and reopen evidence. The experimental.10 macOS package evidence is historical; current distribution is source only.
phases.remaining: All required journeys, remaining hardening, supported device/OS matrix, accessibility, reproducible release SBOM automation, clean-machine validation and Developer ID signed/notarized releases.

brush_benchmark.scope: Synthetic 4K engine and snapshot timing; not full input-to-display latency

drawing_selection.scope: Overlapping tile-boundary moves, shared untouched tiles, sparse transparency, source-over compositing, flips and four quarter turns, vector identity and art/palette preservation, undo and atomic rejection. Free affine transforms, transparent raster resampling and explicit vector-ID membership. Point insertion interpolates pressure and preserves metadata; deletion enforces minimum geometry and rejects analytic primitives. Sparse additive selection and zero-offset duplicate identity output preserve enclosed bystanders and raster media; outputs remain unpublished on rejected edits.

brush_opacity.scope: Coverage at zero/partial/full opacity; eraser works with transparent selected swatch.

visual_animation.scope: Bezier endpoint/overshoot/channel isolation/opacity and retiming; invalid handle rejection; schema 1/2 backup migration; thin-stroke picking at 0.1–10x with rotated nonuniform transforms; native pose and curve gestures. Full-pose retiming preserves values/easing, linked easing validates all channels, collisions reject atomically.
visual_animation.limitations: Synthetic mouse/tablet input; physical tablets, Linux/Windows qualification and production-scale performance pending.

key_blocks.scope: Sparse moves, proportional retiming, rounded/cross-key collisions, duplicates, local pose/pivot/easing clipboard transfer, locked edits, undo/redo and persistence. Native grouped input gestures and focus-safe shortcuts. Batch interpolation removes stale easing; full-pose outgoing presets and bounded repetition preserve gaps and reject collisions atomically.
key_blocks.limitations: Full poses on one selected layer. No world-space retargeting or channel masks; no production-size performance or physical-device qualification.

motion_path.scope: Direct X/Y key editing on evaluated canvas trajectories with atomic preview, parent-space mapping and fixed local references. Native hierarchy, view, insertion and persistence checks.
motion_path.limitations: Integer-frame sampled display. No independent spatial spline, path tangents, separate velocity, parent-key editing, dense-scene or physical-device qualification.

vector_authoring.scope: Cross-scene clipboard and swatches, explicit vector arrangement/stacking, batch style rejection, protected-corner smoothing, bounded pressure-aware simplification and concave whole-footprint lasso. Native authoring journey with Undo and persistence.
vector_authoring.limitations: Whole vectors only; clipboard is application-local; no raster lasso, partial contours, analytic topology or production-scale qualification.

character_rig.scope: Owner-delegated original-art 19-part inspector workflow: all 41 registered PNGs, role/rest placement, exact reference pixels after paint-order setup, Peg/key preservation, eight mouth choices per view and three choices per hand, localized substitution pixels, coordinated view restoration, independent copy, undo/redo and reopened pixels. Shared-ancestor animated reparent and negative/nonuniform preservation pass renderer checks.
character_rig.limits: Independent second-animator HM-15 review, differently animated branch reparenting, masked poses and reusable portable rig assets remain open.

composition_kernel.scope: Typed graph rejection, alpha/matte, distinct Display/Write, undoable format-6 profile and format-5 migration backup; revision-keyed 96 MiB canvas cache, immutable speculative next-frame worker, stale-ticket rejection, cancellation, hierarchy-aware invalidation and conservative ink regions. Native playback/scrub and expanded alpha/color charts pass. Animated prior 19-part artwork measured 39.19 ms/frame median for linear composition at 1080p on the M1 Pro development host; the latest independent toon redraw measured 37.40-39.11 ms/frame in a three-run follow-up.
composition_kernel.limitations: HM-04 is accepted as a bounded contract; P10 remains open. No persisted user-editable graph, useful effects set, full ROI scheduling, production-scene real-time guarantee or current cross-platform qualification.

output_camera.scope: One animated orthographic output camera with direct framing handles, guides, format-7 persistence, atomic undo and preview/reopened/PNG parity.
output_camera.limitations: No multiplane, perspective, camera switching or physical-tablet qualification; P06 remains in progress.

deformation_mesh.scope: Format-8 per-substitution rest/pose/UV mesh, alpha-bounded registered image and bounded editable-vector proxy, mouse bind/drag/reset/remove, atomic failure, migration, renderer output and 19-part workload. Optimized 19-part posed scene measured 4.79 ms/frame on M1 Pro with prior art and 5.69-6.21 ms/frame with the latest independently redrawn toon artwork.
deformation_mesh.limitations: The accepted HM-05 contract covers static mesh behavior. HM-06 animated bone/curve qualification is tracked separately; raster-tile/mixed-media binding, larger production workload and cross-platform qualification remain open.

deformation_animated.scope: Format-9 per-substitution two-segment bone and cubic curve keys, rest-preserving evaluation, posed canvas grid, direct mouse handles including bone and curve rest-control placement, undo/cancellation/reopen, original assembled 19-part pixels and four-run 3.18 ms/frame 1080p renderer measurement with the latest toon artwork. Format 10 introduced a parent bone-tip link for a child Part; format 11 persists its stable rest tip and distal axis, used by the continuous-limb candidate's hands and feet without duplicate follower motion keys. Properties exposes 1-32 mesh cells per axis and an undoable elbow influence radius; the radius also has an on-canvas rest-mode handle with isolated preview and cancellation. Existing keys are revalidated before weight changes. Scene frame insertion/removal and selected-range Clear maintain deformer keys; same-Part range copy/paste, move and stretch retain exact keyed poses. A separate 15-artwork-Part candidate uses four continuous arm/leg images, one mesh and middle elbow/knee joint per limb; its four posed limbs retain rest pixels and reopen identically. An openable 48-frame study combines the continuous rig with a coordinated face view and hand substitution; native tests check undo, redo and reopened frame parity. One native linked 15-part run measured p95 input-to-frameSwapped 17.18 ms and peak resident memory 275 MB on M1 Pro; four earlier 19-part subset runs measured p95 14.90-16.76 ms and memory below 273 MB. A 480-frame visual shot with face/hand/mouth timing, torso curve and camera push retains one connected silhouette and exact bone-tip/follower alignment throughout all 480 frames. An explicit boundary command matches compatible incoming bone or curve controls to the outgoing evaluated pose; native undo/redo/save/reopen passes on an intentionally unmatched sleeve. This removes the measured frame-300 wrist jump; sampled native interaction and memory meet proposed limits on M1 Pro. Full audio/matte/control shot budgets remain open.
deformation_animated.limitations: HM-06 is not accepted: continuous limb bends and source alpha have been inspected, but owner art approval, broader influence/artifact review, linked complete-shot interaction/memory budgets and artist workflow remain. The bounded link requires a direct child Part, an active two-segment parent bone throughout the scene and rest at frame zero; arbitrary deformer attachments, IK and portable templates remain HM-09. Cross-scene and different-Part deformer-key paste reject until portable rig binding transfer is implemented. Independent drawing paste of a bound Part rejects until mesh clone semantics are defined. Format-10 links infer their initial anchor from the currently exposed frame-zero source during migration because the earlier flag did not store attachment-time coordinates.
